llmfit-advisor v1.0.0

- Initial release of a hardware-aware LLM recommendation tool.
- Detects local system specs (RAM, CPU, GPU/VRAM, unified memory).
- Recommends best-fit local LLMs with optimal quantization, speed estimates, and fit scoring.
- Supports filtering by use case (coding, reasoning, chat, etc.) and fit level.
- Provides detailed JSON outputs for both hardware and model recommendations.
- Includes step-by-step guidance for configuring local model providers (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio).
